glosses: A rule or thesis in Sanskrit grammar or Hindu law or philosophy.
A scriptural narrative, especially a discourse of the Buddha.

examples.text:
Shepard: This Code of the Justicar seems central to your life.
Samara: It is five thousand sutras, and covers every situation one can encounter. I have memorized every word. There is only the Code.

Sách giáo lý của một tôn giáo.
Từ chỉ những sách đọc khi cúng lễ.
